subject: Money
title: How Corporate Tax Works
description: A 60-second lesson on How Corporate Tax Works.

hook.text: Apple earned $94 billion in profit in 2022. Its effective tax rate was around 16%, not the official 21%.

buildup.text: Companies pay tax on profits, not revenue. Every expense—salaries, rent, supplies—gets deducted first.

discovery.text: The U.S. corporate rate dropped from 35% to 21% in 2017. Supporters said it would boost investment.

twist.text: Most of the savings went to stock buybacks, not wages. Companies rewarded shareholders, not workers.

climax.text: Corporate tax is paid by companies but felt by workers, consumers, and shareholders in complex ways.

punchline.text: Corporations pay tax. People feel it.

quiz.question: What do companies pay corporate tax on?
